request.text: Prominent close foley of a magical shallow pool growing a waterwheel. 0-.9s: water curls inward with a full rounded lap and gentle suction. .9-1.6s: wet stone settles with two clear ticks beneath the water. 1.6-3.1s: the pool opens, a steady short cascade begins and a little wooden wheel rolls. 3.1-3.6s: one distinct sluice click, a soft splash and water settles. Clean bright tactile game sound. No voices, music, ambience or reverb.
